call_points.text: Steady-state credit cost of 2% expected by FY28 after clearing provisioning backlogs.
Targeting 2% RoA by FY28, with traction expected in the next two quarters.
Steady-state loan growth guided at 20% to 25%.
Digital transformation program StratoNeXt implementation expected before Q3 FY27.
Secured MARG portfolio grew 133% during the year, driving overall growth.
Retail deposits constitute 92% of total deposits, providing a granular funding base.
Microfinance industry showing signs of stabilization but external factors remain a watchpoint.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Based on the Return of Income filed by the Bank for the Assessment Year 2020-21, a demand notice and notice for penalty, each dated September 22, 2022 was issued by Assessment Unit, Income Tax Department under Sections 156 and 274 read with Section 270 A of the IT Act, respectively, to the Bank demanding to pay a sum aggregating to ₹217.99 million and to show cause as to why an order imposing penalty under Section 270A of the IT Act should not be passed. This matter is currently pending with Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals).

penalties.authority: Office of the Superintendent, GST, Rampurhat, Birbhum Division, West Bengal
penalties.details: An Audit was conducted in the state of West Bengal for FY 2019-20 to FY 2021-22. Department treated the ITC availed by bank as non claimable. Though the Bank filed reply to Show Cause Notice, the department issued Order demanding payment of Rs 1580/- as ITC Reversal and Rs 1580/- as penalty.
penalties.impact: Rs. 3,160 towards ITC Reversal and Penalty.

penalties.authority: Office of the Superintendent, GST, Rampurhat, Birbhum Division, West Bengal
penalties.details: An Audit was conducted in the state of West Bengal for FY 2019-20 to FY 2021-22. The Department treated Exempted income as Taxable income. Bank filed reply to Show Cause Notice, but the department issued Order demanding payment of Liability of Rs 10,366/-, Interest of Rs. 68,812/- and Penalty of Rs. 87,484/-.

guidance.statement: Steady-state credit cost of 2% expected by FY28.
Steady-state loan growth guided at 20% to 25%.

operating_notes.text: The bank raised ₹415 Cr Tier II capital during FY26.
Incremental liability of ₹3.31 Cr charged in Q3FY26 due to New Labour Code.
The bank offloaded books to the extent of ₹650 Cr through IBPC in FY26.
Secured loan mix reached 61% as of March 2026.
Retail deposits constitute 92% of total deposits.
Implementing Oracle FLEXCUBE as new Core Banking System.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): interest earned ₹1,196.45 Cr, net profit ₹23.51 Cr (against a loss of ₹183.19 Cr a year earlier).
ESAF Small Finance Bank Limited uploaded the audio recording of its earnings conference call for Q4 FY2026 and FY2026 on May 4, 2026, at 17:35:56 IST.
ESAF SFB reported Q4FY26 results and guided for 2% RoA and 20-25% loan growth by FY28.
ESAF Small Finance Bank announced the migration of its Core Banking System to Oracle FLEXCUBE from October 23 to October 26, 2026.
